products.name: Azure Security Baseline & Governance (Least-Privilege, Secure Config, Guardrails) — Commercial
products.short_description: A repeatable Azure security baseline and governance — Azure Policy guardrails, least-privilege RBAC, a secure-configuration baseline, and Defender for Cloud to measure and improve posture continuously. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Put guardrails on Azure — secure configuration, least privilege, and policy that enforces itself

An Azure subscription without governance drifts fast: over-privileged owners, public storage, unencrypted resources, and no consistent baseline — exactly what Defender for Cloud and auditors flag. This solution gives you a repeatable Azure security baseline and governance: Azure Policy guardrails that prevent and audit misconfiguration, least-privilege RBAC, a secure-configuration baseline, and Defender for Cloud to measure and improve secure posture continuously.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the Azure governance model (management groups, Azure Policy initiatives, RBAC least-privilege), the secure-configuration baseline, and Defender for Cloud secure score / regulatory compliance.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (an Azure subscription/tenant, Entra ID, Owner/Policy contributor rights, a governance/scope design, Defender for Cloud plan, a pilot scope) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: define scope (management groups/subscriptions), assign Azure Policy guardrail initiatives (audit then deny), tighten RBAC to least privilege, apply the secure-config baseline, enable Defender for Cloud and remediate top findings, validate, pilot, then expand.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — Azure policy/RBAC/secure-config discovery, compliance and least-privilege validation, a governance posture and drift report, safe remediation of over-privilege/misconfig, and a scope/management-group targeting helper.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Azure under governance — policy guardrails preventing misconfiguration, RBAC at least privilege, a secure-config baseline applied, and Defender for Cloud posture improving — instead of drift and audit findings, proven on a pilot scope before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • AZSEC-Discovery.ps1 — inventory Azure Policy assignments, RBAC (incl. standing Owner), and
    • AZSEC-Remediation.ps1 — safe remediation: remove a standing Owner assignment (replacing with a
    • AZSEC-Report.ps1 — governance-posture report: assignments, per-policy compliance, Defender for
    • AZSEC-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — resolve and confirm the management-group / subscription scope
    • AZSEC-Validation.ps1 — confirm the guardrail assignment, least-privilege RBAC, and the

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
